'''Zalaegerszegi Torna Egylet Football Club''' ({{IPA|hu|ˈzɒlɒɛɡɛrsɛɡi ˈtornɒ ˈɛɟlɛt|}}), commonly known as '''Zalaegerszegi TE''', '''Zalaegerszeg''' or '''ZTE''', is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Zalaegerszeg]]. Zalaegerszeg has won one [[Hungarian League]] title in [[2001–02 Nemzeti Bajnokság I|2002]] and one [[Magyar Kupa]] title in 2023."}}
